mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact the S&P 500 over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops as specified but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production and payroll employment increase, it indicates strong economic supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which should boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases as specified but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests price stability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is stable but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate investment (RSAFS) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by $50B in one month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases as specified but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase and unemployment (UNRATE) decreases, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies improve but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) after a recession indicates supply recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by 1.0% in one month
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds as specified but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.
